facts.text: The resort is a beachfront resort in Costa Mujeres, about 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport.
facts.excerpt: Just 30 minutes north of Cancun Airport, our Costa Mujeres beachfront resort captures the spirit of Quintana Roo

facts.text: Cancun International Airport is about 26.9 km from the property.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near The St. Regis Costa Mujeres Resort, Cancun is Cancun International Airport (CUN). CUN is located approximately 26.9 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: The resort was designed by the firm Sordo Madaleno and reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood and metal.
facts.excerpt: Designed by award-winning firm Sordo Madaleno, the resort reimagines Mayan legends in stone, wood, and metal

facts.text: Every room and suite has a private terrace, with views of sunrise over the sea and sunset behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca.
facts.excerpt: each with private terraces, guests witness the sun rise over the sea and set behind the mangroves of Isla Blanca

facts.text: Some suites have private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.
facts.excerpt: Experience total privacy in suites with private pools overlooking the Mesoamerican Barrier Reef and the sprawling mangrove reserve near Isla Blanca.

facts.text: Suites feature astrological motifs brought to life through light and custom fixtures.
facts.excerpt: In our suites, astrological motifs come to life through a delicate play of light and custom fixtures.

facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.
facts.excerpt: Marble bathrooms with soaking tubs.

facts.text: The spa offers ancestral Mayan treatments and rituals inspired by the sea and the legacy of El Meco.

facts.text: Costa Coral serves Mexican cuisine rooted in the biodiversity of the milpa and is open for breakfast and dinner.
facts.excerpt:
Rooted in Mexico's rich culinary legacy and the biodiversity of the milpa, we elevate luxury dining in Cancun.

Open for breakfast and dinner

facts.text: Fish Market is a seafood restaurant with a raw bar, ceviches and shared rice dishes.
facts.excerpt: From the precision of our raw bar to signature ceviches and shared rice compositions, our seafood restaurant in Costa Mujeres honors the integrity of local produce.

facts.text: Palmare Grill is an oceanfront restaurant serving artisanal breads, sun-seared meats and coastal dishes made for sharing.
facts.excerpt: our oceanfront restaurant in Costa Mujeres serves artisanal breads, sun-seared meats, and coastal favorites crafted with local ingredients and designed for effortless sharing

facts.text: Olivia is a specialty coffee spot showcasing Mexican coffees with an artisanal bakery selection.
facts.excerpt: An elevated specialty coffee hub, where each cup becomes a refined daily ritual showcasing premium Mexican coffees, artisanal brewing techniques, complemented by an artisanal bakery selection
